title: Named-root status view and full-table 409 don't show slots reserved by unconfirmed operator releases or unpublished retirements
outcome: An operator can see every slot the named-root capacity counts. GET /api/engram/named-roots and the capacity refusal also list unacknowledged operator releases and unpublished retirements that still reserve capacity, each with its exact selection and a state such as "release pending confirmation; repeat the identical request".
acceptance: The status view and the full-table refusal list each unacknowledged operator release and each unpublished retirement that engram_named_root_capacity counts, with the exact selection to repeat
A test with an unconfirmed operator release shows its reservation in both the status view and the refusal
